description: This Java interface defines a generic Range<T> with methods for comparing, including, and overlapping ranges.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: A Java interface representing a range of values with methods to compare, include, and check overlaps.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if the current range occurs after another range or a value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if the current range occurs before another range or a value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the ending value of this range.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Checks if the start and end points of this range are equal.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the starting value of this range.
